from: The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate
incident_time: 08:43 2018 JAPANESE GRAND PRIX 04 - 07 October 2018 Technical Delegate's Report Last night team personnel of the Renault Sport Formula One Team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eight hour period which commenced at 23:00 on 04 October, eleven hours before the scheduled start time of P1 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P1 at 07:00 on 05 October. This was the first of the two individual exceptions permitted for the Renault Sport Formula One Team during the 2018 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. Last night team personnel of the McLaren F1 Team, who are associated with the operation of the car, were within the confines of the circuit during the eight hour period which commenced at 23:00 on 04 October, eleven hours before the scheduled start time of P1 and ends three hours before the scheduled start time of P1 at 07:00 on 05 October. This was the second of the two individual exceptions permitted for the McLaren F1 Team team during the 2018 Formula One Championship season and therefore no action should be taken. The FIA Formula One Technical Delegate Jo Bauer
